name: add_message
description:
Use this tool ONLY when you need to send an intro/outro message BEFORE or BETWEEN content tools (add_document, add_quiz, add_flashcard, add_challenge).

DO NOT use add_message for simple conversational responses. For simple text replies (no document/quiz/etc), just respond with normal text — the system delivers it automatically.

WHEN TO USE add_message:
- Before a document: add_message("Here's your study guide:") → add_document(...)
- Between content tools: add_document(...) → add_message("Now a quiz:") → add_quiz(...)
- NEVER as the only tool call — if you just want to send text, respond normally without any tool

WHEN NOT TO USE add_message:
- Simple greetings ("Hi! How can I help?") → just respond normally
- Answering questions → just respond normally  
- Any response that doesn't involve content tools → just respond normally

Example valid flow:
1. add_message("Here's your study guide:")
2. add_document(title="Study Guide", content="...")
(system generates final follow-up automatically)

content.description: The text content to display to the user. Use markdown formatting as needed.
